description: This file implements URL handling functionalities including URL encoding, decoding, base64 encoding/decoding, and parsing URL components such as scheme, host, path, query, and fragment. It defines the URL class methods and related utilities within the WPEFramework::Core namespace.

classes.name: URL
classes.description: Represents a URL and provides methods for parsing, encoding, and decoding URL components.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Encodes a source string into URL-encoded format.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes a URL-encoded string into its original form.

methods.name: Base64Encode
methods.description: Encodes binary data into a Base64 string.

methods.name: Base64Decode
methods.description: Decodes a Base64 string into binary data.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a URL string into its components such as scheme, host, path, query, and fragment.

methods.name: ParseDomain
methods.description: Parses the domain part of a URL, extracting host and port.

methods.name: Text
methods.description: Constructs the full URL string from its components.
